packages.name: @lenso/core
notes: Published 0.2.0 includes configuration contracts/bindings/sources, Logger and application instanceId.
requires, context.get and running.get identify the exact installed plugin object. Business methods remain ordinary async functions.

packages.name: @lenso/engine
notes: Published 0.2.0 includes configuration inspection and explicit operation context/confirmation/approval binding APIs.
lenso.config.ts default-exports defineApp; operations, mcpOperations and operationBinding are named exports. Engine authoring belongs in lenso.engine.ts.
Static inspection imports trusted modules and schema converters; it does not run runtime plugin setup or configuration source reads.

packages.name: @lenso/cli
notes: Published 0.19.0 consumes core/engine ^0.2.0. Commands are check, inspect, generate, build, call, dev and help.
invoke accepts an optional trusted OperationBinding; call uses the application named operationBinding export. Business JSON cannot provide trusted actor context or confirmation/approval.

packages.name: @lenso/web
notes: Published 0.2.0 uses oRPC client/server exactly 2.0.0-beta.42 and exposes root, /client and /bun.
WebPluginOptions includes errorStatusMap and requestLifetime telemetry. No React hooks or React package export are supplied; React consumes the typed browser client.

packages.name: @lenso/auth
notes: Published 0.2.0 has optional peers core ^0.2.0, oRPC server exactly 2.0.0-beta.42 and Drizzle ^0.45.3.
Authentication evidence and application policy stay separate; install optional peer packages for the consumed adapter entry.

packages.name: @lenso/db
notes: Published 0.1.1 consumes core ^0.2.0. Public adapters are /bun-sql, /bun-sqlite and /d1.
createDrizzlePlugin preserves native database types. Applications own provider migrations and resource acquisition/cleanup.

packages.name: @lenso/workers
notes: Published 0.2.0 consumes core ^0.2.0. createWorkerHandler assembles and starts a separate app per incoming request.
Platform bindings are borrowed. Streaming body completion or cancellation controls owned app cleanup.

packages.name: @lenso/storage
notes: Published 0.1.1 consumes core ^0.2.0. Providers are /local, /s3 and /r2; Files adapters are /files, /sqlite, /postgres and /fetch.
S3 optional peers are ^3.1147.0 and Drizzle is exactly 0.45.3. Signing and cancellation capabilities vary by provider.
Internal /stream declarations are not a public exported subpath.

packages.name: @lenso/tasks
notes: Published 0.2.0 includes queue instanceId/pluginId/logger options and task context/producer trace metadata.
Public entries are root and /postgres; no Workers task provider exists. Queue submission, worker startup and durable cancellation remain distinct operations.

packages.name: @lenso/log
notes: Published 0.2.0 exports createLogger with Pino 10.4.0 and pino-pretty 13.2.0.
Bun Pino runtime behavior does not imply a Workers logger transport. Never put credentials in log fields.

packages.name: @lenso/otel
notes: Published 0.2.0 exposes root/browser, /bun, /orpc and /workers.
oRPC instrumentation peers are optional and exactly 2.0.0-beta.42. Bun and Workers have distinct bootstrap and lifetime requirements.

packages.name: @lenso/mcp
notes: Published 0.2.0 exports serveStdio and an optional trusted binding; dependencies are CLI ^0.19.0, Engine ^0.2.0 and MCP SDK 1.32.1.
mcpOperations selects an independent application operation set, falling back to operations when omitted; the launch allowlist still limits exposure.
Calls serialize through a trusted process identity. No remote authentication, resources, prompts, shell, durable rollback or forced service cancellation is supplied.

packages.name: @lenso/manage
notes: Published 0.2.0 exports root, /agent and /orpc. defineManage selects existing Operations for one exact plugin instance.
createManageAdapter borrows an existing RunningApp and requires per-invocation binding plus canList policy. It does not start or stop the app.
Agent tools require convertible object input schemas; createManageRouter requires optional Auth ^0.2.0 and oRPC server exactly 2.0.0-beta.42.
View hints and namespaced JSON extensions do not provide a Console UI, authentication, automatic authorization, scheduling or persistent audit.
